name: Porum Volunteer Fire Department
label: Supported: wrong town
confidence: Strong locality evidence; precise operational entrance not surveyed
finding: The county's signed 2024 apparatus contract identifies the department at 205 North 2nd Street in Porum, postcode 74455. Overture assigns the same street number and department name to Muskogee, postcode 74401-6635, about 44.4 km away. Its supplied building layer retains the OSM station building in Porum; no compatible fire place lies within 200 m of that site.
interpretation: A coordinate–locality conflict is supported. Confusion between the same street address in different towns is a plausible mechanism, but the source-processing step has not been established. The other endpoint also intersects a building, so footprint overlap alone would not detect this error.
next_check: Confirm the exact current entrance with the department before proposing a replacement coordinate. Use this case in the discovery narrative.

name: Broken Arrow Fire Station #3
label: Supported: stale station location
confidence: Strong official address and relocation evidence
finding: OSM places Station 3 at 5420 South 23rd Street. Overture's same-name record lists 8000 South Elm Place, 3.9 km away. The city-authored 2021 annual report says the new Station 3 opened on 23rd Street in August 2021; the current city facility directory also lists 5420 South 23rd. The new site's building is present in Overture but no fire-category place lies within 200 m.
interpretation: The coordinate and address are inconsistent with the replacement station that opened roughly five years before this snapshot. The city's 2021 news archive describes replacement of the older Station 3 on South Elm Place. This urban case shows that stale location records are not confined to rural communities.
next_check: Use as a supported recurrence example, distinguishing a stale relocation from Porum's wrong-town assignment.

finding: The department publishes 37551 Shoreline Highway.
